dedupe_keys.name: bro basisregistratie ondergrond dutch key register of the subsurface with broloket data portal soil and ground investigations groundwater monitoring and use mining act data environmental quality models

description: The Basisregistratie Ondergrond is the Dutch government's key register of the subsurface, and BROloket is its public portal, built and run by TNO's Geological Survey of the Netherlands for the Ministry of the Interior. The pages read on 2026-09-28 state that under the BRO act all public data on the Dutch subsurface are available through this one portal, which offers subsurface data, subsurface models, a stratigraphic nomenclature and web services. The register's product documentation lists quarterly catalogue releases from 2020 to mid 2026 and groups the registered objects into soil and ground investigations, groundwater monitoring, groundwater use, Mining Act data, environmental quality and models. Coverage is the Netherlands. Access is free; the licence was not read. Caveats: the portal is in Dutch, and object types and formats vary by domain and release. It supports hazard and resilience studies, such as characterising soft soils under dikes and roads for flood defence or subsidence assessment, or estimating induced earthquake site effects in Groningen. Related records: the Dutch building register BAG and cadastral map.
